name: rise63-tests
description: Test tooling only. RISE 63 itself has no JavaScript build step and no runtime dependencies. PGlite is here so tests/e2e.php can run real SQL: php-wasm has no MySQL driver, and the alternative was tests that are written but never executed.

scripts.test: node tests/support/phpwasm-guard.mjs && node tests/support/phpwasm-test.mjs && node tests/support/phpwasm-render.mjs && node tests/support/phpwasm-smoke.mjs && node tests/support/phpwasm-e2e.mjs && node tests/support/phpwasm-pages.mjs && node tests/support/offline-behaviour.mjs && node tests/support/combobox-behaviour.mjs && node tests/support/assets-and-cache.mjs
